lines.say: Meta just changed three things that decide what you pay for ads.
lines.show: Meta just changed [3 things] that decide what you [pay for ads].

sections.label: ① PHOTO → VIDEO
sections.source: Source: Meta for Business · Advertising Week New York, 6 Oct 2026

lines.say: One. Meta can now turn one product photo into a video ad.
lines.show: One: Meta can turn [1 product photo] into a [video ad].

lines.say: So I don't need a video shoot?
lines.show: So I [don't need] a video shoot?

lines.say: Not to start testing. It's built into Ads Manager.
lines.show: Not to start testing. It's [built into Ads Manager].

sections.label: ② META'S NEW AD AI
sections.source: Source: engineering.fb.com (13 Oct) · Meta for Business (19 Oct 2026)

lines.say: Two. Meta has a new AI that decides who sees your ads.
lines.show: Two: a [new Meta AI] decides who sees your ads.

lines.say: Meta says it gets about nineteen percent more conversions.
So I just run my one best ad, right?
lines.show: So I just run my [one best ad], right?

lines.say: No. It rewards variety. Run different ads: photo, video, carousel.
lines.show: No. It [rewards variety]. Photo, video, carousel.

lines.say: Three. WhatsApp replies now cost money after a thousand free a month.
lines.show: Three: WhatsApp replies [cost money] after [1,000 free] a month.

lines.say: Even when the customer messages me first?
lines.show: Even when the customer [messages me first]?

lines.say: If they came from your ad, it can stay free for up to seven days.
lines.show: If they came from [your ad], it's free for [up to 7 days].

lines.say: Comment META and I'll send you the full checklist.
lines.show: Comment ["META"] and I'll send the [full checklist].
